name: Melithar Staghelm
summary: Outside Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Melithar Staghelm guides young night elves. He sends them to learn why the dryad Tarindrella has returned to the glade. His Staghelm name links him to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, though their connection is unknown.

sections.title: A Guide at Aldrassil
sections.body: Melithar Staghelm waits outside Aldrassil, where night elves first step into the world. A druid who listens to the forest spirits, he has learned that Tarindrella, a woodland protector, has returned to Shadowglen after years away. Sensing trouble, Melithar sends newcomers southwest of Aldrassil to find the dryad and learn why she has come back to the grove.

sections.title: The Staghelm Name
sections.body: The Staghelm name draws notice because Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus, after Malfurion Stormrage disappeared into the Emerald Dream. Melithar makes no claim to a grand heritage and says nothing of his lineage. Whether he belongs to the Archdruid's family or shares an ancient Kaldorei name remains unknown. For now, Melithar tends to his humble duties at the roots of Aldrassil.

faq.answer: Melithar Staghelm is a night elf who guides newcomers outside Aldrassil in Shadowglen. He sends them to find the dryad Tarindrella.

faq.q: Is Melithar related to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm?
faq.answer: Their exact kinship is unknown. Melithar never says whether he is related to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm or Fandral's late son Valstann. He may be a distant relative, or they may simply share a Kaldorei surname.

faq.q: What role does Melithar play for new adventurers?
faq.answer: Melithar sends newcomers southwest of Aldrassil to find Tarindrella, a woodland protector who has returned to Shadowglen after years away. The forest spirits have told him of her return, and he wants them to learn why she has come to the grove.

faq.q: Where can I find Melithar Staghelm?
faq.answer: Melithar Staghelm stands on the wooden ramp outside Aldrassil's entrance, in the center of Shadowglen on Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf setting out in Shadowglen, you meet Melithar soon after leaving Aldrassil's shelter.
